role: SwiftUI Sleep detail screen (pushed from Dashboard sleep card and MorningResultsView sleep card): sleep-score ring hero, quick stats, vitals row, sleep window + Adjust, interactive hypnogram, plus the sections declared in SleepDetailV2View+Breakdown.swift; hosts the SleepTimelineEditorView sheet and a detached 15-night trend computation.
types: SleepDetailV2View: struct (View) — sleep detail screen; inputs session, sleepData, recoveryVitals, recentSessions, temperatureUnit, typicalSleepHours, userAge, onRefresh, onAdjust
SleepDetailV2View.SleepStageKind: enum — stable stage key (deep/rem/light/awake) for stage-pill toggling and explanation dispatch
SleepDetailV2View.SleepDataIdentified: struct (Identifiable) — UUID wrapper so SleepData can drive .sheet(item:)
state: mem:SleepDetailV2View.expandedStage (@State SleepStageKind?, internal so the Breakdown extension can toggle it)
mem:SleepDetailV2View.refreshedVitals (@State RecoveryVitals?, HealthKit re-fetch on appear)
toplevel: Declares ten @ScaledMetric font sizes bound to text styles (20-29), the stored inputs (31-39) with onRefresh/onAdjust optional closures defaulting to nil, @Environment(RRCollector) and the @State properties. SleepDataIdentified.id is a fresh UUID() per wrapper (115). No #if blocks.

flags.text: onRefresh is never supplied by any caller (DashboardV2View and MorningResultsView construct the view without it; tests too), so the menu's "Refresh sleep data" item never renders; the toolbar menu only ever contains "Edit sleep", and in a context without onAdjust it is an empty menu button.

DashboardV2View passes `session` (which may have no sleep snapshot) together with sleepData from a different night (latestWithSleep). This view then mixes nights: the Sleep HR stat uses `session`'s strap meanHR, the vitals refresh uses `session`'s end date, and the editor's "refresh from HealthKit" fetches `session`'s recording window while the edit is saved to the other night.

units.does: Returns the localized display label (Deep/REM/Light/Awake) for a SleepStageKind from LanguageManager.appBundle.

Merges the passed-in recoveryVitals (stored) with the HealthKit-refreshed refreshedVitals field by field (fresh wins for resp/SpO2/temp), and sets restingHeartRate to the session strap analysis meanHR, else stored RHR, else fresh RHR. With neither stored nor fresh returns a heart-rate-only vitals or nil.

units.does: Wraps a strap/stored RHR into a RecoveryVitals with every other field nil; returns nil when mergedRHR is nil.

Computes the sleep score for sleepData via RecoveryScoreCalculator.calculateSleepScore: SleepScienceAnalyzer.analyze(...).enhancedScore, or basicSleepScore when analyze returns nil (night minutes <= 0); 0 when sleepData is nil. Recomputed on every access (no caching).

branches.effect: falls back to 0; heroSection shows the ring empty state in that case

flags.text: sleepScore is an uncached computed property; each body evaluation runs SleepScienceAnalyzer.analyze about six times (sleepScore and verdict at 288, verdict twice at 306/308, computeSleepBreakdowns at 152, structureCells at 476), including on every hypnogram scrub tick, the cost the trendNights cache comment says it avoids for the trend.

units.does: Wraps sleepScore in a ScoreVerdict (word/colour ladder).
SwiftUI body: wraps sleepStack in withSleepEditor (editor sheet + trend task).
Builds the ScrollView of sleepCards with background, localized "Sleep" title, toolbar menu button, and a .task keyed on session.id that calls refreshVitals.
units.entry: Rendered from body; .task(id: session.id) runs refreshVitals on appear and whenever session.id changes

units.does: Stacks hero, quick stats, vitals, sleep window, hypnogram, stage breakdown, score breakdown, insights, trends, structure and age-group cards in a VStack.

Attaches the SleepTimelineEditorView sheet bound to editorSleepData and a .task keyed on trendInputsKey that runs SleepDetailV2View.buildTrend on a detached userInitiated task and stores the result in trendNights.
units.entry: .sheet(item:) presents when editorSleepData is set; .task(id: trendInputsKey) runs on appear and on key change

flags.text: The trend key omits inputs calculateSleepScore reads (napSleepMinutes for duration, boundarySource for measuredSleepEfficiency, inBedMinutes, interval contents beyond count), so an edit that changes only those leaves a stale trend bar until another key field changes; the comment on trendInputsKey says it covers the fields the score reads.

The .task assigns the detached buildTrend result without checking Task.isCancelled; Task.detached is not cancelled when SwiftUI cancels the keyed task, so a superseded computation that finishes after the newer one overwrites trendNights with the stale trend.

units.does: Builds SleepTimelineEditorView for the wrapped SleepData; onSave calls the onAdjust closure and clears editorSleepData; onRefreshFromHealthKit re-fetches sleep from HealthKit for this session's recording window (end = endDate or start+8h), returning nil on missing collector or any thrown error.
